findings.title: Compute the queued timestamp for each assignment source
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated when the module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource.from_integration()` call in a worker reuses that timestamp. Consequently, outbound tasks serialize the module-import time as `queued`, even for assignments received hours or days later. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so each source records its own creation time.
